# Steal An Egg Wiki

> Independent English Roblox wiki for Steal An Egg by and Collect Rare Pets, Place ID 107778070777162.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/): Game entity, gameplay loop and wiki topic hub
- [Eggs](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/): Egg database and mechanics
- [Divine Eggs](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/divine-eggs/): Divine Egg paths, rarity context and how-to-get guidance
- [Rare Eggs](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/rare-eggs/): Rare and secret egg evidence
- [Spawn Predictor](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/spawn-predictor/): Browser timer for user-entered egg spawn observations and next-spawn estimates
- [Best Eggs](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/best-eggs/): Verification-first egg tier list, risk and progression rankings
- [Pets](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/): Pet rarity and income database
- [Rarest Pets](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/rarest-pets/): Highest verified rarity pets, acquisition context and rarity-versus-value guide
- [Best Pets](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/best-pets/): Verification-first pet tier list, income and progression rankings
- [Guide](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/guide/): Beginner gameplay guide
- [Progression](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/progression/): Upgrades, pens, trails and earnings
- [Steal An Egg Calculator](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/calculator/): Local income, upgrade-goal and egg-run planning calculator
- [Speed & Treadmill](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/progression/speed-treadmill/): Movement progression
- [Codes](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/codes/): Verified active and expired code status
- [Updates](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/updates/): Verified game update log
- [Sakura Event](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/updates/sakura-event/): Great Bloom, Crane, Sakura Incubator and event verification guide
- [Monster Update](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/updates/monster-update/): Titan Temple, Hungry Monster, Monster Egg, Monster Chest and Mutant Shark
- [What Happened to Steal An Egg](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/updates/what-happened-to-steal-an-egg/): Removal, deletion rumors, return timeline and live status
- [Rarities](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/rarities/): Rarity system, rarity order, Secret, Eternal and Divine tiers
- [Stag Egg](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/stag-egg/): Secret Stag Egg location, how to get it, rarity and hatch details
- [Ice Dragon](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/ice-dragon/): Ice Dragon source, rarity, pet value and verification status
- [Koi](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/koi/): Koi and Koi Egg search-intent guide with verification-first source details
- [Dodo](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/pets/dodo/): Dodo pet guide and Dodo Egg terminology clarification
- [Parasite Egg](https://steal-an-egg.github.io/eggs/parasite-egg/): Parasite Egg source, rarity, hatch and Monster Update evidence status

## Accuracy policy

The wiki does not invent egg odds, pet income, upgrade costs, code rewards or update dates. Unconfirmed values are marked as not verified.
